intro.title: Sliding Window Maximum (Deque)
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that finds the maximum value in every possible subarray of a fixed size within a given array, using the sliding window technique. You will learn how to implement this efficiently using a deque (double-ended queue) to track potential maximum candidates as the window moves. The core programming concepts involve array traversal, queue operations, and maintaining optimal data structures for performance. You will work with JavaScript arrays and implement custom logic to manage the deque, focusing on time complexity optimization for this common algorithmic pattern.
intro.usecase: The sliding window maximum algorithm is essential for real-time data analysis in financial dashboards, where traders need to track the highest stock price within a moving time window. It powers performance monitoring tools that display peak server load or maximum network latency over rolling intervals. This pattern also enables efficient filtering in data visualization systems, such as showing the highest temperature or maximum sales value across consecutive time periods in analytics applications.
